s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly progressive renal failure with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Poor appetite and fatigue for a week
Decreased daily urine output to less than 50 mL/d
Laboratory tests showing severe renal impairment and anemia
key_facts: No history of Raynaud phenomenon, swollen fingers, rashes, joint pain, coughing, or wheezing
Urine analysis showing occult blood 3+ and protein 1+

shortlist.label: IgA nephropathy
shortlist.why_kept: IgA deposition in mesangial area and hematuria

shortlist.label: Lupus nephritis
shortlist.why_kept: ANA positive, anti-SM positive, and low complement levels

shortlist.label: Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid decline in renal function and presence of cellular crescents

shortlist.label: Anti-glomerular basement membrane disease
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly progressive renal failure and presence of hematuria

shortlist.label: ANCA-associated vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly progressive renal failure and systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient has a positive ANA, anti-SM, and U1-NRNP, which are specific autoantibodies associated with lupus, along with low complement levels (C3 and C4) and kidney biopsy findings showing large amounts of IgA deposition and cellular crescents, which can be seen in lupus nephritis.

rejected.label: IgA nephropathy
rejected.why: While IgA deposition is present, the patient's positive ANA, anti-SM, and U1-NRNP suggest a systemic autoimmune disease like lupus rather than isolated IgA nephropathy.

rejected.label: Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis
rejected.why: This diagnosis could be considered due to the rapid decline in renal function, but the presence of specific autoantibodies points more towards an autoimmune cause like lupus nephritis.

rejected.label: Anti-glomerular basement membrane disease
rejected.why: There is no mention of anti-GBM antibodies, which are characteristic of this disease.

rejected.label: ANCA-associated vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of ANCA positivity or other typical features of vasculitis like granulomatosis with polyangiitis.

gold: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with IgA Nephropathy and Acute Progressive Glomerulonephritis
